title: Agent (entity in the predication-graph bearing predications about acting)
description: An agent is an entity in the predication-graph store that bears predications about acting on the substrate — addressable like any other entity, not a privileged process outside the graph. Per lab/.../predicated-agentic-orchestration-platform/agent/agent.md (lab uses 'predicated-' prefix from pre-grammar-stabilization; cleaner current name is just agentic-orchestration-platform — the path types it). Distinguishing predications: identity (who), capability (what skills the agent can invoke), operative (what the agent has done). Meets agentic-system conditions (environmentalAction, goalDirectedPlanning, persistentState) AND satisfies agential-self-generation. Per emsenn 2026-05-28 caveat: modeled players ARE agents in concurrent game systems — the agent is the substrate-side view, the modeled-player is the CGS-strategy-bearing view, same entity through two lenses.
